Class ComputedGridModel

java.lang.Object
de.schladebeck.fx.grid.model.AbstractGridModel
de.schladebeck.fx.grid.model.ComputedGridModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
GridModel
public class ComputedGridModel extends AbstractGridModel

A model whose values come from a function, so any size costs no memory:

GridModel times = new ComputedGridModel(1_000, 1_000, (row, column) -> (row + 1) * (column + 1))
        .columnNames(column -> "x " + (column + 1))
        .rowNames(row -> "y " + (row + 1));

The function runs on the JavaFX application thread for every visible cell on every repaint, so it must be fast. Call refresh() when its results change, e.g. because they depend on time or on other data.

The changing methods and the builders may be called from any thread, see AbstractGridModel.applyChange(Runnable).
